title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the time required to freeze the water.

title: Heat Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the heat released during the freezing process.

title: Efficiency Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct formula for the efficiency of the motor in their calculations.

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the minimum work required using the heat calculated and the efficiency.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of work and efficiency.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should correctly convert temperatures from Celsius to Kelvin when necessary.
